name: Encroaching Darkness (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Path of the Ravaging Void

Benefit: The nightblade gains the ability to create a wider effect with her elemental shade and can do so from further away. The nightblade’s elemental shade increases in size to a 30 ft. radius, and can be created from any point in space within 100 feet.
